_what: Every judge verdict, kept because a verdict that lives only in a chat is not a gate.

verdicts.finding: There IS a state change at frame zero, so this is not a tour and not a veto - but the reveal does not RESOLVE inside the 2.00s window. The tear begins at 0.00s (shot 0), the window then cuts away to a lateral tracking shot of the car (shot 1, 1.21s), and the uncovered summit only lands at 2.41s in shot 2, outside the gate. Worse for a phone: at frame zero the plan puts the peak in the upper third and the car 'small in the lower third', so nothing is LARGE at 0.00s. KK's hook worked because the car FILLED the frame.
verdicts.fix: Reprompt A so the tear COMPLETES inside its own 1.21s window with the summit filling the upper half of frame, and change B's framing at shot 1 from a lateral track to a PUSH toward the peak so the second beat continues the reveal instead of changing subject. Both are free, plan-time, pre-probe.

verdicts.finding: A real consequence chain exists and it is human-caused twice, but it is bunched at the two ends: consequence boundaries sit at 2, 6, 15 and 16, which leaves EIGHT consecutive boundaries (7 through 14, 8.45s to 19.32s - a third of the video) where nothing happens because of anything. That stretch is cows, valley, cows, he stands, car parked, he stands at a railing, car detail. It is the exact KK v15 failure restated: nothing happens TO the person. There is also no friction anywhere in the day - nothing goes even slightly wrong, so nothing needs resolving.
verdicts.fix: Convert one middle boundary into a real cause. Cheapest version with no new source: reprompt D's second window (shot 8) so the cloud is rolling BACK IN over the valley, making boundary 9->10 a consequence - the weather is closing, SO he pulls over and gets out at 13.28s. That gives the middle a cause and gives the golden-hour run something to have earned.

verdicts.finding: ABSOLUTE VETO on card 3, 'MINI NEW ZEALAND, THEY SAY' at shots 11-14. The CONTENT block verifies exactly two facts - the two-hour drive and the 06:00-08:00 clearest window - against explorekundasang.com fetched 2026-08-06. The New Zealand epithet is verified by NOTHING. 'THEY SAY' hedges the attribution but does not source it, and an unsourced attribution is precisely the crown J4 class one day later. Secondary and independent: the card is also placed wrong. Shots 11-14 are the parked car, the railing and a wheel detail; the only pasture-and-rolling-green footage in the whole plan is shots 7-9, which is where that line would have to sit to be about anything on screen.
verdicts.fix: Either cite a datable 2026 source for the nickname in CONTENT.verified, or replace the card with a fact the plan already owns and move it onto the pasture beats - e.g. 'DAIRY COUNTRY, 2 HOURS UP' across shots 7-10, which reuses the already-verified drive time and describes what is actually in frame.

overall.one_line: J4 vetoes: card 3 asserts an unsourced nickname - verify it against a 2026 source or replace it with the drive time and move it onto the pasture shots.

verdicts.finding: The reveal now RESOLVES inside its own 1.21s window - A's prompt makes the tear fast and finished within the first second, the summit fills the upper half of frame instead of the upper third, and the car is sized to read at phone scale. Shot 1 no longer interrupts: B now shoots UP the road into depth with the uncovered peak held above, so 0.00-2.41s is one continuous reveal instead of a reveal and then a different picture. Remaining risk is generation, not plan: 'fast tear finishing in one second' is a timing instruction to a model that does not take timing instructions well, and only the probe will show whether it obeyed.
verdicts.fix: None at plan level. Judge A at the probe against this exact criterion: is the peak uncovered by 1.00s, and is the car readable at 720x1280 without zooming. If not, that is a reroll of A alone at 22.5cr, not a replan.

verdicts.finding: The dead middle now has a cause. D's second window carries the weather turning - cloud rolling back over the terraces - and boundary 9->10 is a real consequence at 13.28s: the cloud closes, SO he pulls over and gets out. That also retro-justifies the whole back half, because the golden-hour run at 19-24s is now light that was nearly lost rather than light that was always going to be there. Five consequences at 2, 6, 9, 15, 16. Still honest to say the strongest stretch is the ends: boundaries 10 through 14 are arrival, parked car, railing, detail, face - five boundaries of arranging rather than happening.
verdicts.fix: Optional and free if you want an 8: give shot 13 (the car detail, golden starting) a small human trace - a hand on the wing, a door left open - so the object beats still belong to the person. Not required to ship.

verdicts.finding: Veto lifted, on both counts. Card 3 no longer asserts a nickname in our voice - it quotes Daily Express Malaysia's published phrasing, 'Sabah's own little New Zealand', and CONTENT.verified now names that source plus independent attestation in Tripadvisor reviews of Desa Dairy Farm. The card also moved from shots 11-14 to 8-11, so it sits on the pasture and valley footage it actually describes. The other three cards are a verified drive time, a verified viewing window and a question. Nothing on screen asserts a price, a spec or a market status - the GLC300 lineup fact stays in CONTENT with its fetch date, which is the correct place for something that goes stale.
verdicts.fix: One standing risk, not a plan defect: the epithet is a REPORTED nickname, so if a card ever drops the attribution it becomes the crown class again. Keep the quoted framing.

overall.one_line: Plan clears all three seats - the remaining risk moved to generation, so probe A alone and judge the tear timing before the other nine clips.

verdicts.finding: Shot 0 is a genuine body event, not a tour, but FRAMING has the subject dropping INTO frame from above, so frame 1 is an empty pool and the 2s window opens text-empty.
verdicts.fix: Pin the drop to frame zero in source A's prompt and move card 1 onto shot 0.

verdicts.finding: Only 1 of 5 declared consequence boundaries is a real cause; 0->1 is an editorial rewind, 4->5 asserts a parking that is in no shot, 14->15 and 15->16 are tautologies of locomotion, and shots 11-16 hold one unchanged state for 7.2s.
verdicts.fix: Give the exit a body cause (23C water) and put a real consequence inside the 11-16 span.

verdicts.finding: Card 1 '90 MINUTES FROM KK' asserts the low end of a 1.5-2h range as fact and its claimed two-source agreement is false - sabahparks.org.my states no drive time; separately no prompt banned a registration plate or rear badge on the GLC.
verdicts.fix: Change the card to the upper bound with a hedge, record the source disagreement, and ban plate/badge text in _LOOK.

overall.one_line: the drive-time card is wrong and its cited agreement does not exist

verdicts.finding: Frame zero is a real body event and the thumb stops at ~0.4s, but shot 1 handed the decision beat to source B, a long-lens valley establisher - the most inert image in the timeline - so the second half of the 2s window drained the grab instead of compounding it.
verdicts.fix: Swap shot 1 from B to C so 1.21-2.41s holds a face and near-field motion.

verdicts.finding: Boundary 11's declared cause is absent from shot 11 (source E is a person-free cross-gorge long lens), boundary 4's cause was written into shot 5 instead of shot 4, boundary 14's cause is already present in the same clip at shot 12, and shots 16-19 close on 7.48s of two alternating clips with zero causal boundaries.
verdicts.fix: Move each cause into the writing of the shot BEFORE its boundary, and put an event in the 16-19 tail.

verdicts.finding: All four cards verify clean against four independent sources, but _LOOK is appended to every SOURCE prompt and to NO PLATE prompt, and PLATES['glc300'] was framed three-quarter front with an explicit request for real tyre sidewall lettering and no registration-plate ban - an invented Malaysian plate would be baked into the 4cr reference image and carried into six shots, and planqc's plate check only tests resolution.
verdicts.fix: Ban plate/badge/tyre lettering in the plate prompt itself and LOOK at the rendered plate before it is used as a reference.

overall.one_line: the text bans lived on the clips and not on the plate every clip cites

verdicts.finding: Frame zero is a real body event resolving by ~0.7s and the cabin shot now holds the second half of the window, but the card sits on top of the splash from 0.00s and competes with the one arresting frame.
verdicts.fix: Start the ABOUT 2 HOURS FROM KK card at the 1.21s cut (start=1, span 4) so the event owns frame zero uncontested.

verdicts.finding: Only boundary 4 survives the visible-cause test; boundary 9's entering-the-water act exists only in source A's first half second which shot 0 already spent, boundary 12 asserts source E's static cross-gorge long lens is the phone's own frame, and boundary 14's before and after states are two windows of the SAME clip G, while shots 16-19 hold 7.2s of one state cut four times out of two clips.
verdicts.fix: Delete the third E window and the H/I repeat, and spend the runtime on one new source containing him leaving the water, so boundary 14 has a before and after in two different clips.

verdicts.finding: Every card fact verifies independently and signage, plates, badges and phone screens are genuinely banned, but the plan positively requests an unenumerated text surface - the persona's 'white PRINT shirt', centre frame on the hook - and the declared clipqc text-zoom read excluded the HUMAN clips where that surface lives; CONTENT.claim's 'barely waist deep' also drifts from its own sourced 1.3m.
verdicts.fix: Ban clothing wordmarks and instrument displays in _LOOK, extend the text-zoom eyeball to all nine clips, and correct the depth wording.
verdicts.where: _LOOK; SOURCES A and C; PLATES mahua must_show; CONTENT.claim

overall.one_line: the story spine still rests on state changes that live inside one clip instead of across a cut

verdicts.finding: Shots 16 and 18 are two windows of the single source H and the plan cannot control which end of the clip's arc each one takes; separately shot 15's note claimed a walk OUT that source D - forward-moving toward the gorge in every frame - cannot deliver, and shot 13's note claimed E's static cross-gorge tripod long lens is the frame a phone at arm's length produced.
verdicts.fix: Pin non-overlapping in-clip windows per shot for source H, and write only what each clip can actually deliver into its note.

overall.one_line: the tail's arc depends on a window order the plan cannot specify

verdicts.finding: The consequence chain is real but short - shots 8 to 12 - and it DIES at 12, leaving 39% of runtime with no verifiable cause; 3 of 5 declared consequences carry a token that lives only in the shot note and not in either source prompt; boundary 7 action/grass is impossible because K is a static wide with no person, boundary 13 audio/calf names a sound neither prompt writes, boundary 15 gaze is impossible on a macro glass with nobody in frame; and shot 11 replays source A whose own prompt says the event resolves inside one second, so the payoff lands on spent frames.
verdicts.fix: Give shot 11 its own source, write the carry tokens into the SOURCE PROMPTS rather than the notes, and put the goats and the descending road into H's frame so the tail's causes are visible.

overall.one_line: the carries live in the shot notes, which the generator never reads
